linux.command: bash -c 'setsid pnpm dev & VitePid=$!; echo $VitePid > .vscode/vite.pid; trap "kill -INT -- -$VitePid 2>/dev/null; wait $VitePid 2>/dev/null; rm -f .vscode/vite.pid; exit 0" INT TERM EXIT; wait $VitePid'

windows.command: $PID | Set-Content '.vscode/vite.pid'; try { pnpm dev } finally { Remove-Item '.vscode/vite.pid' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

linux.command: bash -c 'if [ -f .vscode/vite.pid ]; then PID=$(cat .vscode/vite.pid); kill -INT -- -$PID 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f .vscode/vite.pid; fi'

windows.command: if (Test-Path '.vscode/vite.pid') { $ProcId = Get-Content '.vscode/vite.pid'; taskkill /PID $ProcId /T /F | Out-Null; Remove-Item '.vscode/vite.pid' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Remove-Item index.html
